name: THOMAS CHACRA
tagline: Bioengineer | Python, large datasets & energy analysis
addressee: To the Trends & Analysis team, Transport & Environment.
subject: Application: Shipping Analyst Intern, Trends & Analysis
paragraphs: Shipping is one of the few sectors where a spreadsheet can still move a policy, and that is exactly the work I want to do. FuelEU Maritime, the EU ETS extension to shipping and the IMO framework are decisions taken on the strength of the numbers behind them; I would like to be one of the people producing those numbers.

Most of my work has been data work with a deadline attached. I have cleaned and validated large environmental datasets, documented the quality rules behind them, and automated analyses that cut processing time by around 70 percent. I have also worked with energy demand and time-series data, built Power BI dashboards that non-specialists actually used, and turned technical results into charts and messages for people who had ten minutes to read them. My tools are Python, SQL, Power Query and Excel.

My maritime knowledge is limited so far, and I would rather say so than dress it up. What I bring is the ability to learn a model quickly, to ask the question that exposes a weak assumption, and to check whether a figure survives scrutiny before it reaches a briefing. I work in English and French, and I am based in Brussels and happy to come into the office every week.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could support the shipping modelling work, and I thank you for considering my application.
